newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 8.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Retailer Country Road Ltd said on Tuesday group trading profit for the first half of the 1996/97 year could be more than 50 percent below last year's record result for the first half.
Just Jeans Ltd said late on Tuesday that it expects pre-tax profit for the 26 weeks to January 25, 1997 to be 50 percent lower than a year earlier.

Insurance group HIH Winterthur Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy all the shares in Colonial Mutual General Insurance Co Ltd, a unit of the unlisted Colonial Mutual group, for an undisclosed sum. It said the acquisition and the formation of an alliance with the Colonial group would generate new premium in 1997 of A$80 million, growing to A$140 million within three years.
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.82 (-0.12)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd late on Tuesday confirmed it has stopped production and disconnected the floating platform from the Griffin oil field to avoid the path of cyclone Rachel, which is bearing down on the Western Australia coast.

Electronics group AWA Ltd is looking at bidding up to A$750 million to buy 75 percent of the New South Wales government-owned betting agency the Totalisator Agency Board (TAB), The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Wednesday.

Emperor Mines Ltd said on Tuesday it had identified from drilling so far an inferred mineral resource of about 526,500 tonnes grading 8.6 grams per tonne (g/t) gold at its Tuvatu prospect in Fiji. This would equal about 145,000 ounces of gold, Emperor said.
